paite: Huai lou leng Ahithophel in Absalom kiang ah, "Mi singkhat-le-sangnih ka telkhe dia, tuzan in David delh ding in ka kuan ding.
heading: Hushai In Absalom Apikhial
english: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

paite: Abah lai leh hat louh laitak ka va phanon dia, ka va lausak ding. Huchi in akiang a mi tengteng ataimang ding uh. Huchi in kumpipa kia ka va that mai ding.
english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

paite: Na kiang ah mipite ka hon pikik nawn vek ding. Na mizonpa mi tengteng hong kik toh kibang ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng khamuang in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

paite: Huan hiai thugen in Absalom leh Israel upate akipaksak hi.
english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Absalom in, "Arki mi Hushai sam peuhmah phot inla, amah gendan i ngaikhe peuhmah ding uh," achi hi.
english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

paite: Absalom kiang a Hushai ahong tun in Absalom in, "Ahithophel in hichibang in agen a, agen bang a hih ding i ding uam? Hih lou ding hi leng nang hon gen himhim dih," chi in ana houpih hi.
english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

paite: Hushai in Absalom kiang ah, "Tutung a Ahithophel lemtheihna ahoih kei," achi hi.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

paite: Hushai in, "Na pa leh amite na thei a, sepaih hangsantak, gam a vompi anou laksak bang mai ahi uh. Na pa lah galdoumi ahi a, mipi lak ah agiak khol kei ding.
english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

paite: Ngai in, tu in leng koi lai leihawm hiam ah, koi lai mun ah hiam a kibu ahi ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, akisual tung ua mi khenkhat apuk ualeh aza peuh in, Absalom zuite athat ek uh, achi mai ding uh.
english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

paite: Huchi in mihangsantak, humpinelkai lungsim bang pumi hial leng ahong lungke mahmah ding uh. Israel mi tengteng in lah na pa sepaih hangsantak ahihdan leh akiang a mi omte mihangsan taktak ahihdan uh athei vek ngal ua.
english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

paite: Kei hoihsak sam dan, Israel mi tengteng Dan a pan Beer-sheba pha in tuipi a piaunel zah hial ding na kiang ah samkhawm vek lehang; kidouna ah nang nangawn kuan lechin.
english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

paite: Huchi in koi lai mun peuh ah i kituahna na ah lei a daitui kia bang mai in i boh ding ua; amah leh akiang a mi om tengteng khat lel leng i hawi kei ding uh.
english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

paite: Huai lou leng, khua a alutleh Israel mi tengteng, khauhual tawi in huai ah i va hoh ding ua, suang neuchik leng om lou hial khop in lui ah i kaikhe vek ding," achi hi.
english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

paite: Huchi in Absalom leh Israel mi tengteng in, "Ahithophel thuhilhna sang in Arka mi Hushai thuhilhna ahoihzaw," achi uhi. TOUPA'N Absalom tung a thil hoih lou atunsak theihna ding in Ahithophel thuhilhna hoihtak nuaisiah ding in ana sep khin him hi.
english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.

paite: Huchi in Hushai in siampu Zadok leh Abiathar kiang ah, "Huchibang khachibang in Ahithophel in Absalom leh Israel upate hoih ding in angaihtuahpih a; ke'n huchibang khachibang in hoih ding in ka ngaihtuah hi.
heading: David Hilhkholh In A-om A, Asuakta
english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

paite: Huaiziak in tuzan in gamdai lui kainate a giak nawn lou in kan ngeingei un. Huchi lou in zaw kumpipa leh akiang a om tengteng ahihmang vek kha ding uh chi in David hilhsak zok un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

paite: Khopi sung alut uh kuama'n amuhlouhna ding un, Jonathan leh Ahimaaz bel En-rogel ah a-om ua; sikhanu khat in amaute ava hilh zel hi. Amau kumpipa David ava hilhsawn zel uhi.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

paite: Himahleh naupang in ana mu a, Absalom ahilh hi. Himahleh anih un ataimang pah ua, Bahurim a mi khat, a-intual a tuileh nei inn ah ava hoh ua, tuileh sung ah alutsukta uhi.
english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

paite: Numei in tuileh asitna in asin a, atung ah buh aphou a, kuama'n athei kei hi.
english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

paite: Absalom sikhate numei kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Ahimaaz leh Jonathan koi a om ahi ua?" achi uhi. Numei in akiang uah, "Luita tui akanta ding uh," ana chi hi. Ava zong ua, amu kei ua, Jerusalem ah akik nawn uh.
english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, apaitum khit un tuileh a pan ahong pawtkhia ua, kumpipa David ava hilh uhi. David kiang ah, "Pawtkhia unla, tui kan pah un, huchi in Ahithophel in ahon tum hi," achi uh.
english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

paite: Huchi in David leh akiang a mi om tengteng apawtkhia ua, Jordan lui akan uh. Khua ahong vak in Jordan lui kan lou khat lel leng a-om kei uh.
english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

paite: Ahithophel in ahoihsakdan azui kei uh, chih atheih in asabiltung avan a, apawtkhia a, akhua ah apai hi. A-inkuante khosakna ding abawlsak sipsip a, huchi in a-awklumta hi. Amah asita a, apa han ah avui uhi.
english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

paite: Huchi in David, Mahanaim ava tung hi. Absalom in akiang a Israel mi tengteng toh Jordan lui akan uhi.
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

paite: Absalom in Joab sik in Amasa sepaih heutu ding in akoih hi. Amasa bel mi khat amin Ithra tapa ahi. Ithra ahihleh Israel mi, Joab nu sanggam Nahash tanu Abigail zi a neipa ahi.
english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

paite: Israel mite leh Absalom in Gilead gam ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mahanaim a David atun in, Ammon suan Rabbah a mi Nahash tapa Shobi, Lo-debar a mi Amiel tapa Makir leh Rogelim a Gilead mi Barzillaite'n
english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

paite: lupnate, maiphiat kuangte, leibelte, huit buh, barli buh, tangbuang, be kankeu,
english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

paite: khuaizu, mokhon, belamte, ganhon a pan nawikhalte, David leh akiang a om mite nek ding ahon tawi uhi, "Gamdai ah mite agilkial ua, atawl ua, adangtak uh," achih ziak un.
english: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”
